title: LatticePolicy outbound message envelope, version 1
description: Every message LatticePolicy delivers, by webhook or by Kafka, is this envelope. Delivery is at least once: treat messageId as an idempotency key.

messageId.description: Stable across redeliveries of the same message.

tenantId.description: The carrier the message belongs to.

type.description: What happened, for example ledger.commission_handoff. Route on this.

topic.description: Same value as type. Kept for consumers of the original webhook.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the payload contract when the payload declares one, for example commission-handoff.v1.

attempt.description: Delivery attempt this copy belongs to.

createdAt.description: When the message was recorded, in the same transaction as the change it describes.

payload.description: The message body. Its shape depends on type.
